Name: Black Tuxedo Cat
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
This mod changes your cat to be a tuxedo cat. 

[b][u]Installation[/u]
RECOMMENDED: Backup your old cat.xnb file (found in your [code]Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/code] folder)
[/b]1. Download the file.
2. Navigate to your [code]Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/code] folder.
3. Paste the new cat.xnb file into the Animals folder.
4. Replace the files.
5. Launch Stardew Valley and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Changes your cat to a black tuxedo cat.
